    - Butea monosperma — key for insect biomass; also provides branch cover for arboreal snakes
    - Diospyros melanoxylon — dry-deccan staple, fruit for mammals, rough bark for climbing
    
    The short version: planting figs + Terminalia + Ziziphus + Acacia gives you trees that feed rodents → which feed snakes → AND provide denning/basking habitat. A diverse native dry-deciduous mix is better than any one species.
